messages:
Maya: Heads-up: scheduled KMS key rotation tonight at 02:00 UTC. Quick check — are we still allowing TLS 1.2 between control-plane and some legacy model runners? Also, any session-ticket or raw handshake material leaking to logs? cc @Sam
Sam: We dropped TLS 1.2 for public endpoints but a few legacy runners still accept 1.2 on port 9001. I'm planning a policy roll to force TLS1.3 tonight. Will confirm logs shortly.
Ops-bot: Rotation scheduled: KMS key 'rl-key-prod' rotation starting 2026-03-18T02:00Z. Tasks: notify owners, rotate, validate.
Sam: Quick checks you can run locally:
Sam: ```
# check negotiated protocol/ciphers
openssl s_client -connect runner-01.internal:9001 -tls1_2
# or use sslyze
sslyze --regular runner-01.internal:9001
```
Sam: For logs, grep fluentd/forwarder for session ticket remnants:
Sam: `grep -R 'session_ticket' /var/log/fluentd || true` — shouldn't find any raw ticket bytes.
Maya: If we're forcing TLS1.3, can we do a small canary (runner-01..03) first? Need to avoid breaking Dedicated customers.
Sam: Yep. Canary group = runner-01, runner-02, runner-03 (us-west). I'll config canary rollout and post status.
Luca: I approve the KMS rotation. Confirmed no key material in logs from last audit. Please ensure rotation events go to security-audit ACL.
Security-bot: Audit rule updated: `kms.rotation` events forwarded to #security-audit. Update applied at 1823456900.
Maya: Thanks. Sam — ping me when canary completes so I can prep docs & customer comms.
Sam: Will do. I'll start the canary in ~15m and post results here. :thumbsup:
